last_etwap_base_supply.meaning: stored exponential TWAP of base token supply (lastETWAPBaseSupply) at the time the subsequent mint is evaluated

threshold_crossed.meaning: a prior mint crossed the noCapLimit threshold, adding just over one token

subsequent_mint_attempted.meaning: a subsequent mint is attempted after the threshold is crossed

mint_cap_revert_occurred.meaning: the subsequent mint reverts with E_LEX_MintCapExceeded

assumptions: The subsequent mint is within the cap and would otherwise be a valid deposit.
The first over-threshold mint is performed by any user; no special authorization is required to mint.
The stored ETWAP remains near zero at the time the subsequent mint is evaluated.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the first over-threshold mint itself succeeds or reverts, so the exact state at the subsequent mint is not fully pinned.
Report gives no numeric definition of 'within the cap' for the subsequent mint; the cap relation is only described qualitatively.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the mint_cap_revert impact; deposit-blockage duration and ETWAP recovery timing are not covered here.
The near-zero ETWAP magnitude is represented symbolically; no concrete numeric value is asserted.
The noCapLimit threshold value is not given numerically and is represented by the threshold_crossed occurrence symbol.
